headline: Carrick under pressure as winless United visit Chelsea
summary: Manchester United go to Stamford Bridge without a win in five matches, and Michael Carrick's job is in question after a 4-1 defeat at Como, according to BBC Sport. United have conceded 1.66 expected goals per game in that run. Chelsea, by contrast, won 2-0 at Everton on Saturday. Across the market, margin removed, Chelsea are 48.5% to win — almost double United's 26.9% — and rated 0.5 goals better on the handicap, a head start in goals. The goals line is 3.0. One warning: United won 1-0 here in April, and took the last two meetings.
read: Chelsea are clear home favourites at 48.5%, rated about half a goal the better side on the handicap, against a United team without a win in five and with Michael Carrick under pressure after a 4-1 defeat at Como. The market expects goals — the total is set at 3.0 — and the one note of caution for Chelsea is that United have won the last two meetings between the clubs.

facts.fact: Manchester United were beaten 4-1 at Como in the Champions League this week, and BBC Sport reports Michael Carrick's job is in jeopardy.
facts.meaning: United arrive at Stamford Bridge in the middle of a managerial story, not just a bad run of results.

facts.fact: Chelsea are 48.5% to win at home, almost double United's 26.9%.
facts.meaning: The home side is a clear favourite, but short of a two-in-three chance — this is not priced as a formality.

facts.fact: Manchester United have not won in five matches — LDLDD.
facts.meaning: Three of those were draws, so United are not being blown away every week, but they are not winning either.

facts.fact: United sit 13th in the Premier League with seven points from seven games.
facts.meaning: A point a game, and a bottom-half position going into a trip to the side in fourth.

facts.fact: The goal total for this game is set at 3.0.
facts.meaning: Over 3.0 is the slightly favoured side at 52.9%, so an open game is expected at Stamford Bridge.

facts.fact: United have conceded 1.66 xG per game across their last five while creating 1.08.
facts.meaning: The results are not bad luck — they are being out-created, and by a distance.

facts.fact: Chelsea won 2-0 at Everton on Saturday, with the xG 1.47 to 0.43.
facts.meaning: A third win in five for Chelsea, and their most controlled performance of the run.

facts.fact: United won 1-0 at Stamford Bridge in April and have won the last two meetings between the clubs.

sources.fact: Chelsea released an official injury update on Emiliano Martinez from the club's website.
BBC Sport reports that Josh Acheampong's playing time at Chelsea had been in doubt, with genuine questions over how much he would feature in a season without European football.
Yahoo Sports reports Chelsea consider Josh Acheampong 'untouchable' and an integral part of Xabi Alonso's plans.
Chelsea beat Everton 2-0 away in the Premier League, according to a post-match player ratings piece.
Football London reports Xabi Alonso took 'extreme' action in Chelsea training ahead of the Tottenham test.
BBC Sport reports Michael Carrick's job is in jeopardy after Manchester United suffered one of the worst European nights in their history, losing 4-1 to Como.
Michael Carrick said after the Como defeat: 'I'll take responsibility for the overall team and performance, it stops with me and I'm fine with that.'
ESPN reports Manchester United are on their worst start since 1986.
